name: uberasm-reset-level-on-falling-down-offscreen-v1
title: Reset Level on Falling Down Offscreen V1.1
description:
This UberASM works as Level and Game Mode 14 ASM. Instead of dying when falling offscreen, the level will restart as if you reentered it from the overworld.

Note: This doesn't work on level 24 unless you disable it's gimmick in Lunar Magic!

yoshifanatic's Update:
- Removed the SA-1 check because it's redundant as UberASM already does this.
- Added support for Lunar Magic 3.00's horizontal level modes.
- Added midpoint support, so this code can teleport you to the midpoint of a level if you have it.
- Significantly optimized the code for getting a teleport destination.
